protocol: Unmodified PR55 native engine; four real qualifying sessions and races, 13 vehicles, beginner AI with expert ordinary player inputs. Only the existing public one-lap race-length option. No pose, speed, rank or time writes. Captured to test reading a genuinely won previous-format Run, not to claim a current weak-car win.
